title: feat(spec): the bound record blocks accept an authored emptyState, drawn only when their dataSource binding answers no row
body:
Fixes #24266

Clause-②: yes (widening)

## What changes

The three bound record blocks, `record:details`, `record:highlights` and `record:quick_actions`, each accept an optional authored `emptyState`. This is the spec half of objectstack-ai/objectui#12932.

- **The key.** `RecordDetailsProps`, `RecordHighlightsProps` and `RecordQuickActionsProps` each gain `emptyState: EmptyStateSchema.optional()`. The schema is referenced, not re-spelled: it is the list view's own `EmptyStateSchema` (`view.zod.ts`), already imported into `component.zod.ts` for `object-grid.emptyState` (#20694). Importing it adds no new module edge, so there is no `lazySchema` cycle.
- **The condition.** All three rows share one describe, `BOUND_RECORD_BLOCK_EMPTY_STATE_DESCRIPTION`, which is not exported, the same way `RECORD_BLOCK_REQUIRED_PERMISSIONS_DESCRIPTION` is shared. It says the empty state is drawn when the block's `dataSource` binding answers no row, and only then. It is never drawn on a block with no binding, which reads the record page's record instead. A loading read and a failed read are not "no row" either. On `record:quick_actions`, a bound record whose bar resolves no action keeps the existing empty placeholder.
- **Declared ahead of its renderer (AGENTS.md Prime Directive #10).** No renderer reads the key yet. Each describe opens with `[PLANNED — not yet rendered]`, the marker `check-liveness.mts` `MARKER_RE.planned` reads. `liveness/page.json`'s `_note` gains a PLANNED RECORD sentence naming the carrier, objectstack-ai/objectui#12932. A component-level key gets no ledger row because the walk stops at the undrilled `page/regions` container. This is the same pattern `RecordRelatedListProps.parentDataSource` (#23134) followed.
- **Ledger.** `dropped-refinements.baseline.json` declares `emptyState.link.url` on the three rows. The build refused until it did. It is the same `EmptyStateLink` URL refinement that `ui/ObjectGridProps` and `ui/ListView` already declare.
- **Generated.** `authorable-surface/ui.json` gains three `emptyState` rows, and `content/docs/references/ui/component.mdx` is regenerated. Both were written by `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` and `gen:docs`, not by hand.

## Measurements (mechanism hypotheses)

- **H1 (premise holds).** On `origin/main` `a422f04fe`, all three rows are `strictObject`s with no `emptyState`, and the file's only `emptyState` is `ObjectGridPropsSchema`'s.
- **H2 (no fourth block).** In objectui `main` `79cb8c03e`, `git grep recordBindingBlock` matches exactly three call sites: `record-details.tsx:1132`, `record-highlights.tsx:199` and `record-quick-actions.tsx:469`. `record:related_list`'s `parentDataSource` is a second binding that already declares its own no-row answer (a loud absence), so this key does not go on that row.
- **H4 (no lint change).** `packages/lint/src/validate-component-props.ts` derives known keys from `ComponentPropsMap`, and no lint pin enumerates these rows' key sets.

## Tests

The pin file is `packages/spec/src/ui/component-record-blocks-empty-state-24266.test.ts`. It runs 25 cases in four parts:

- §1: each block parses a full `emptyState` and a one-member one, and a block without the key still parses with no default added.
- §2: an unknown inner key is refused with `unrecognized_keys` at path `emptyState`, and a re-spelled member is refused inside `emptyState`. As a lit control, an unknown top-level key is still refused at the row. `record:related_list` still refuses the key.
- §3: each member unwraps to `EmptyStateSchema`'s own def, by identity, which is also `object-grid`'s.
- §4: each describe opens with the planned marker.

All runs below were on the tree of head `40ef667d`. The WIP commits were squashed into that head and their tree is byte-identical.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: 694 files and 21027 tests pass, exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test:repo`: 67 of 68 files passed. The 68th, `view-data-api-provider-retirement.test.ts`, failed with ENOENT on `packages/spec/json-schema/qa`. A concurrently running gate (`check:authorable-surface`) was regenerating that gitignored tree while the test walked it. Re-run alone, the file passes 10 of 10.
- **Ablation.** I deleted `record:quick_actions`' `emptyState` line through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. The anchor went from 1 hit to 0, the blob changed from `2365c6de` to `778818d7`, and 6 cases turned red. The file was then restored: blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: all 14 artifacts are up to date. The 111 commands from `dispatch-gates --commands` came back with 108 at exit 0. Three are NOT MEASURED locally, all with exit 3 for an unmet prerequisite:
  - `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:lean-entry-closure` need a whole-workspace build.
  - `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needs an unshallow clone.

  CI runs all three.

## Acceptance notes

- The key validates and is not yet drawn until objectstack-ai/objectui#12932 lands against a spec release that carries it. The describe marker and the `_note` sentence state that, and both come out when that card lands.
- The `measured.refinementSitesThatDidProject` field in `dropped-refinements.baseline.json` reads 369 on `main`, while the build prints 467. That drift was already on `main` and is not touched here. I only moved the two counts this diff changes: published schemas 236 to 238, and dropped sites 767 to 770.
